"""P2 - zero-copy reads: numpy views on SeqRing slots + per-slot sequence (seqlock) validation.

Part A - torn-read safety (adversarial). One spawned writer writes UNTHROTTLED into a SeqRing of length L at 1280x720.
Frame k's image is entirely the byte value (k % 251) (copied from a 251-image pool), so any mix of two frames is
detectable. The parent reads continuously for RUN_A_S per config with one of three reader styles:
  copy_fncheck   : the CURRENT SkellyCam pattern (get_data_by_index, ring_buffer_shared_memory.py L175-202): check
                   head-k < L, read frame_number, np.copyto the pixels out, accept iff frame_number == k. (Emulated on
                   SeqRing so it can share the harness; the real class was shown to tear in the verified code map W20.)
  seqlock_copy   : s1=seq; np.copyto pixels out; s2=seq; accept iff s1==s2==2k+2
  seqlock_view   : s1=seq; cv2.resize(VIEW of slot, 0.5, dst=prealloc) (= the UI use, no copy out); s2=seq; accept iff stable
and two target patterns: latest (k = head) and oldest (k = head-(L-1), the slot the writer overwrites next).
"silent tear" = accepted but the pixels are from >1 frame (checked on 9 sampled rows of the copy / resized result).

Part B - read cost with 5 spawned 60 fps writers (1080p and 720p), cold read of the newest frame right after it is
published, RUN_B_S per style, styles interleaved 5 rounds: seqlock_copy (1 copy out), seqlock_view (acquire+validate,
0 copies), seqlock_view_resize (view -> resize into prealloc -> validate), plus a 5-camera multiframe of each.

Run (from C:\\Users\\Dom\\GitHub\\freemocap\\skellycam): .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p2_seqlock_read.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

RUN_A_S = float(os.environ.get("P2_RUN_A_S", "10"))
RUN_B_S = float(os.environ.get("P2_RUN_B_S", "2"))
POOL = 251
ROWS = None


def adversarial_writer(spec, h, w, ready_q, stop_evt, out_q):
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    pool = np.empty((POOL, h, w, 3), np.uint8)
    for p in range(POOL):
        pool[p] = p
    k = 0
    ready_q.put(1)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    while not stop_evt.is_set():
        s = ring.begin(k)
        np.copyto(ring.image_view(s, (h, w, 3)), pool[k % POOL])
        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=0)
        k += 1
    out_q.put(dict(frames=k, fps=k / (time.perf_counter() - t0)))
    ring.close()


def paced_writer(spec, cam, h, w, fps, ready_q, stop_evt):
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    sensor = pcm.FakeSensor(fps, seed=cam)
    ready_q.put(cam)
    k = 0
    while not stop_evt.is_set():
        tick, t_ns = sensor.grab()
        s = ring.begin(k)
        np.copyto(ring.image_view(s, (h, w, 3)), frames[k % 30])
        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=t_ns)
        k += 1
    ring.close()


def torn(arr, rows):
    """True if the sampled rows of arr are not all one value."""
    v = arr[rows]
    return bool(v.min() != v.max())


def part_a():
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    h, w = pcm.SIZES["720p"]
    rows = np.linspace(0, h - 1, 9).astype(int)
    rows_half = np.linspace(0, h // 2 - 1, 9).astype(int)
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")

        for pattern in ("latest", "oldest"):

Topology (all spawned processes): 5 camera processes (FakeSensor 60 fps, latest-frame-wins, same model as the baseline
FakeCapture) each write frames into their own SeqRing; 5 recorder processes each consume THEIR camera's ring strictly
in order from a private cursor (cursor = last frame fully handed to the encoder). The camera loop never encodes.

Full-ring policies compared (what the camera does when the slot it needs still holds an unconsumed frame):
  overwrite : current SkellyCam policy (put_frame(overwrite=True), opencv_camera_loop.py L96): write anyway. The recorder
              detects a lapped slot (seq != 2k+2) and counts the lost frames itself - after the fact.
  block     : camera waits for the recorder; sensor ticks keep coming and are counted (FakeSensor.skipped) - explicit.
  drop      : camera skips the frame and increments ring_full_drops in the ring header - explicit.

Part A (sweep, synthetic recorder work): recorder "encode" = a 2 ms busy wait reading the slot view (stands in for an
async encoder hand-off), plus ONE injected stall of S ms on every recorder at t=3 s (all 5 at once, like a disk stall).
1920x1080, L in {16, 64, 172 (SkellyCam's 1 GiB default)}, S in {200, 1000, 2500, 3500} ms, 8 s per run.
Prediction: a stall of S ms is lossless iff S*60/1000 < L - (normal backlog); i.e. L=172 tolerates ~2.8 s.

Part B (real encoder): recorder = cv2.VideoWriter(fourcc 'X264') -> MSMF H.264 on this machine (same writer SkellyCam's
VideoRecorder uses), fed the slot VIEW (zero-copy hand-off; cursor advanced only after write() returns), L=172, policy
block, 1080p and 720p, 20 s, with one injected 1500 ms stall at t=8 s. Checks: recorder lag distribution (slots),
frames in file == frames produced, consecutive frame numbers, and decoded-content identity on every 10th frame
(each decoded frame must match synthetic frame (fn % 30) better than any other - catches slot reuse corruption).

Run (from C:\\Users\\Dom\\GitHub\\freemocap\\skellycam): .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p3_lossless_record.py [A] [B]

from __future__ import annotations

import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

N_CAMS = 5
FPS = 60.0


def camera(spec, cam, h, w, policy, run_s, ready_q, go_evt, out_q):
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go_evt.wait()
    sensor = pcm.FakeSensor(FPS, seed=cam)
    gated = 0 if policy == "overwrite" else 1
    k = 0
    blocked_ns = 0
    block_events = 0
    drops = 0
    produced = 0
    t_end = time.perf_counter_ns() + int(run_s * 1e9)
    pub_lat = []
    while time.perf_counter_ns() < t_end:
        tick, t_tick = sensor.grab()
        if not ring.can_write(k, gated):
            if policy == "drop":
                drops += 1
                ring.hdr[pcm.H_DROPS] = drops
                continue
            b0 = time.perf_counter_ns(); block_events += 1
            while not ring.can_write(k, gated):
                time.sleep(0.0002)
            blocked_ns += time.perf_counter_ns() - b0
        t0 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        s = ring.begin(k)
        np.copyto(ring.image_view(s, (h, w, 3)), frames[tick % 30])
        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=t_tick, aux0=tick)
        pub_lat.append(time.perf_counter_ns() - t0)
        k += 1
        produced += 1
    ring.hdr[pcm.H_BLOCK_NS] = blocked_ns
    out_q.put(dict(cam=cam, produced=produced, sensor_skipped=sensor.skipped, ring_full_drops=drops,
                   blocked_s=blocked_ns / 1e9, block_events=block_events, publish=pcm.stats_ms(pub_lat)))
    ring.close()


def recorder(spec, cam, h, w, policy, mode, stall_at_s, stall_ms, video_path, ready_q, go_evt, stop_evt, out_q):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    vw = None
    if mode == "msmf":
        vw = cv2.VideoWriter(str(video_path), cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"X264"), FPS, (w, h))
        backend = vw.getBackendName()
    else:
        backend = "busy2ms"
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go_evt.wait()
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    stalled = False
    nxt = 0
    consumed = 0
    lost_lapped = 0
    lags = []
    write_lat = []
    tick_to_written = []
    fns = []
    gated = policy != "overwrite"
    max_lag = 0
    while True:
        if not stalled and time.perf_counter() - t_start >= stall_at_s:
            stalled = True
            time.sleep(stall_ms / 1000)
        hd = ring.head
        if nxt > hd:
            if stop_evt.is_set() and ring.head < nxt:
                break
            time.sleep(0.0005)
            continue
        lag = hd - nxt + 1
        max_lag = max(max_lag, lag)
        lags.append(lag)
        sl = nxt % ring.L
        s1 = int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_SEQ])
        if s1 != 2 * nxt + 2:
            # lapped (overwrite policy): frame nxt is gone. Jump to the oldest frame that is still stable.
            new = max(nxt + 1, ring.head - ring.L + 2)
            lost_lapped += new - nxt
            nxt = new
            continue

        t0 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        if vw is not None:
            vw.write(view)
        else:

            while time.perf_counter_ns() < busy_end:
                acc += int(view[0, 0, 0])

            lost_lapped += 1  # overwritten while being encoded -> encoded data is torn; count as lost
        else:
            fns.append(int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_FN]))
            tick_to_written.append(t1 - int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_TICK]))
        write_lat.append(t1 - t0)
        consumed += 1
        if gated:
            ring.set_cursor(0, nxt)
        nxt += 1

    if vw is not None:

                   lag_p99_slots=float(np.percentile(lags, 99)) if lags else 0, lag_median_slots=float(np.median(lags)) if lags else 0,
                   write=pcm.stats_ms(write_lat), tick_to_written=pcm.stats_ms(tick_to_written), release_s=rel_s,
                   fns_first_last=(int(fns_a[0]), int(fns_a[-1])) if len(fns) else None))
    ring.close()


def verify_video(path, h, w, cam, n_expected):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    small = np.stack([cv2.resize(f, (w // 8, h // 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).astype(np.int16) for f in frames])
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(path))
    n = 0
    mism = 0
    checked = 0
    while True:
        ok, img = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        if n % 10 == 0:
            s = cv2.resize(img, (w // 8, h // 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).astype(np.int16)
            d = np.abs(small - s).mean(axis=(1, 2, 3))
            # frame n of the file is frame_number n -> sensor tick? we only know frames[tick%30]; content index is
            # recorded per frame by the camera (aux0 = tick). Here we only test "matches SOME clean synthetic frame
            # much better than the 2nd best" to catch torn/corrupted slots.
            o = np.sort(d)
            checked += 1
            if not (o[0] < 0.5 * o[1]):
                mism += 1
        n += 1
    cap.release()
    return dict(decoded_frames=n, expected=n_expected, content_checked=checked, content_ambiguous_or_torn=mism,

    ready_q, out_cam, out_rec = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue()
    go, stop = ctx.Event(), ctx.Event()

    for p in cams + recs:
        p.start()
    for _ in cams + recs:
        ready_q.get(timeout=300)
    cpu_samples = []
    import threading
    cpu_stop = threading.Event()
    th = threading.Thread(target=pcm.cpu_sampler, args=([p.pid for p in cams + recs], cpu_stop, cpu_samples), daemon=True)
    th.start()
    go.set()
    cres = sorted([out_cam.get(timeout=run_s + 120) for _ in cams], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    stop.set()
    rres = sorted([out_rec.get(timeout=300) for _ in recs], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    cpu_stop.set()
    for p in cams + recs:

        r.close()

    for v in vids:
        if v.exists():

    return dict(size=size_name, L=L, policy=policy, mode=mode, stall_ms=stall_ms, stall_at_s=stall_at_s, run_s=run_s,

                produced_total=sum(c["produced"] for c in cres), recorded_total=sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres),
                recorder_lost_total=lost_total, ring_full_drops_total=sum(c["ring_full_drops"] for c in cres),
                sensor_skipped_total=sum(c["sensor_skipped"] for c in cres),

                all_consecutive=all(r["consecutive"] for r in rres),
                lossless_on_disk_path=(lost_total == 0 and all(r["consecutive"] for r in rres)
                                       and sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres) == sum(c["produced"] for c in cres)))


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    parts = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a in ("A", "B")] or ["A", "B"]
    out_path = "p3_lossless_record.json"
    prev = {}
    if (pcm.RESULTS / out_path).exists():
        import json
        prev = json.loads((pcm.RESULTS / out_path).read_text())
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), part_a=prev.get("part_a", []), part_b=prev.get("part_b", []))
    if "A" in parts:
        out["part_a"] = []
        for L in (16, 64, 172):
            for stall in (200, 1000, 2500, 3500):
                for pol in ("overwrite", "block", "drop"):
                    r = run("1080p", L, pol, "busy", stall, 3.0, 8.0)
                    out["part_a"].append(r)

                    print(f"A L={L} stall={stall} {pol}: produced {r['produced_total']} recorded {r['recorded_total']} "
                          f"recorder_lost {r['recorder_lost_total']} ring_full_drops {r['ring_full_drops_total']} "
                          f"sensor_skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} blocked_max {r['blocked_s_max']:.2f}s maxlag {r['max_lag_slots']} "
                          f"consecutive {r['all_consecutive']}", flush=True)
    if "B" in parts:
        out["part_b"] = []
        for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
            L = 172 if size_name == "1080p" else 388
            r = run(size_name, L, "block", "msmf", 1500, 8.0, 20.0)
            out["part_b"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json(out_path, out)
            print(f"B {size_name} L={L}: produced {r['produced_total']} recorded {r['recorded_total']} lost {r['recorder_lost_total']} "
                  f"sensor_skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} maxlag {r['max_lag_slots']} files "
                  f"{[(f['decoded_frames'], f['expected'], f['content_ambiguous_or_torn']) for f in r['files']]} cpu {r['cpu'] and r['cpu']['sum_processes']:.0f}%",
                  flush=True)
    write_md(out)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)


def write_md(out):
    import proto_common as pcm
    L = ["# P3 - lossless record path (decoupled recorder, gated cursor) vs current overwrite policy", "",
         "## A. Stall-tolerance sweep: 5 cameras 1080p @60 fps, 5 recorders (2 ms synthetic work), one simultaneous stall at t=3 s, 8 s runs", "",
         "Totals over 5 cameras. `recorder lost` = frames the recorder never got (lapped; overwrite policy). `ring-full drops` = frames the "
         "camera explicitly skipped (drop policy). `sensor skipped` = sensor ticks never grabbed (includes block-policy back-pressure; "
         "~0-5 per run is scheduler noise).", "",
         "| L (s @60) | stall ms | policy | produced | recorded | recorder lost (silent today) | ring-full drops (explicit) | sensor skipped | max blocked s | max lag slots | consecutive | lossless after ring |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in out.get("part_a", []):
        L.append(f"| {r['L']} ({r['ring_seconds_at_60fps']:.2f}) | {r['stall_ms']} | {r['policy']} | {r['produced_total']} | {r['recorded_total']} | "
                 f"{r['recorder_lost_total']} | {r['ring_full_drops_total']} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | {r['blocked_s_max']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['max_lag_slots']} | {r['all_consecutive']} | {r['lossless_on_disk_path']} |")
    L += ["", "## B. Real encoder (cv2 'X264' -> MSMF H.264) as a decoupled recorder, block policy, 20 s, one 1500 ms stall at t=8 s", "",
          "| size | L | produced | recorded | lost | sensor skipped | max lag slots | lag p99 (worst cam) | write() median / p99 / max ms (worst cam) | tick->written median / p99 ms | files decoded == produced | content torn/ambiguous | release s | CPU sum % (cams+recorders) |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in out.get("part_b", []):
        wr = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["write"]["p99_ms"])
        tw = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["tick_to_written"]["p99_ms"])
        files_ok = all(f["decoded_frames"] == f["expected"] for f in r["files"])
        L.append(f"| {r['size']} | {r['L']} | {r['produced_total']} | {r['recorded_total']} | {r['recorder_lost_total']} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | "
                 f"{r['max_lag_slots']} | {max(x['lag_p99_slots'] for x in r['recorders']):.0f} | {wr['write']['median_ms']:.2f} / {wr['write']['p99_ms']:.2f} / {wr['write']['max_ms']:.2f} | "
                 f"{tw['tick_to_written']['median_ms']:.1f} / {tw['tick_to_written']['p99_ms']:.1f} | {files_ok} "
                 f"({[f['decoded_frames'] for f in r['files']]}) | {sum(f['content_ambiguous_or_torn'] for f in r['files'])} of {sum(f['content_checked'] for f in r['files'])} | "
                 f"{max(x['release_s'] for x in r['recorders']):.2f} | {r['cpu']['sum_processes'] if r['cpu'] else float('nan'):.0f} |")
    pcm.write_text("p3_lossless_record.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        if not gated and int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_SEQ]) != s1:
            lost_lapped += 1  # overwritten while being encoded -> encoded data is torn; count as lost
        else:
            fns.append(int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_FN]))
            tick_to_written.append(t1 - int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_TICK]))
        write_lat.append(t1 - t0)
        consumed += 1
        if gated:
            ring.set_cursor(0, nxt)
        nxt += 1
    rel_s = 0.0
    if vw is not None:
        r0 = time.perf_counter(); vw.release(); rel_s = time.perf_counter() - r0
    fns_a = np.asarray(fns)
    out_q.put(dict(cam=cam, backend=backend, consumed=consumed, recorded=len(fns), lost_lapped=lost_lapped,
                   consecutive=bool(len(fns) < 2 or np.all(np.diff(fns_a) == 1)), max_lag_slots=max_lag,
                   lag_p99_slots=float(np.percentile(lags, 99)) if lags else 0, lag_median_slots=float(np.median(lags)) if lags else 0,
                   write=pcm.stats_ms(write_lat), tick_to_written=pcm.stats_ms(tick_to_written), release_s=rel_s,
                   fns_first_last=(int(fns_a[0]), int(fns_a[-1])) if len(fns) else None))
    ring.close()


def verify_video(path, h, w, cam, n_expected):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    small = np.stack([cv2.resize(f, (w // 8, h // 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).astype(np.int16) for f in frames])
    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(path))
    n = 0
    mism = 0
    checked = 0
    while True:
        ok, img = cap.read()
        if not ok:
            break
        if n % 10 == 0:
            s = cv2.resize(img, (w // 8, h // 8), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).astype(np.int16)
            d = np.abs(small - s).mean(axis=(1, 2, 3))
            # frame n of the file is frame_number n -> sensor tick? we only know frames[tick%30]; content index is
            # recorded per frame by the camera (aux0 = tick). Here we only test "matches SOME clean synthetic frame
            # much better than the 2nd best" to catch torn/corrupted slots.
            o = np.sort(d)
            checked += 1
            if not (o[0] < 0.5 * o[1]):
                mism += 1
        n += 1
    cap.release()
    return dict(decoded_frames=n, expected=n_expected, content_checked=checked, content_ambiguous_or_torn=mism,
                bytes=Path(path).stat().st_size)


def run(size_name, L, policy, mode, stall_ms, stall_at_s, run_s):
    import proto_common as pcm
    h, w = pcm.SIZES[size_name]
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    rings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(L, h * w * 3, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
    ready_q, out_cam, out_rec = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue()
    go, stop = ctx.Event(), ctx.Event()
    vids = [pcm.SCRATCH_TMP / f"p3_{size_name}_{L}_{policy}_{mode}_cam{i}.mp4" for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    cams = [ctx.Process(target=camera, args=(rings[i].spec(), i, h, w, policy, run_s, ready_q, go, out_cam)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    recs = [ctx.Process(target=recorder, args=(rings[i].spec(), i, h, w, policy, mode, stall_at_s, stall_ms, vids[i],
                                               ready_q, go, stop, out_rec)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    for p in cams + recs:
        p.start()
    for _ in cams + recs:
        ready_q.get(timeout=300)
    cpu_samples = []
    import threading
    cpu_stop = threading.Event()
    th = threading.Thread(target=pcm.cpu_sampler, args=([p.pid for p in cams + recs], cpu_stop, cpu_samples), daemon=True)
    th.start()
    go.set()
    cres = sorted([out_cam.get(timeout=run_s + 120) for _ in cams], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    stop.set()
    rres = sorted([out_rec.get(timeout=300) for _ in recs], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    cpu_stop.set()
    for p in cams + recs:
        p.join(30)
    for r in rings:
        r.close()
    cpu = pcm.summarize_cpu(cpu_samples)
    files = []
    if mode == "msmf":
        for i, v in enumerate(vids):
            files.append(verify_video(v, h, w, i, cres[i]["produced"]))
    for v in vids:
        if v.exists():
            v.unlink()
    lost_total = sum(r["lost_lapped"] for r in rres)
    return dict(size=size_name, L=L, policy=policy, mode=mode, stall_ms=stall_ms, stall_at_s=stall_at_s, run_s=run_s,
                ring_seconds_at_60fps=L / FPS, cameras=cres, recorders=rres, files=files, cpu=cpu,
                produced_total=sum(c["produced"] for c in cres), recorded_total=sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres),
                recorder_lost_total=lost_total, ring_full_drops_total=sum(c["ring_full_drops"] for c in cres),
                sensor_skipped_total=sum(c["sensor_skipped"] for c in cres),
                blocked_s_max=max(c["blocked_s"] for c in cres), max_lag_slots=max(r["max_lag_slots"] for r in rres),
                all_consecutive=all(r["consecutive"] for r in rres),
                lossless_on_disk_path=(lost_total == 0 and all(r["consecutive"] for r in rres)
                                       and sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres) == sum(c["produced"] for c in cres)))


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    parts = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a in ("A", "B")] or ["A", "B"]
    out_path = "p3_lossless_record.json"
    prev = {}
    if (pcm.RESULTS / out_path).exists():
        import json
        prev = json.loads((pcm.RESULTS / out_path).read_text())
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), part_a=prev.get("part_a", []), part_b=prev.get("part_b", []))
    if "A" in parts:
        out["part_a"] = []
        for L in (16, 64, 172):
            for stall in (200, 1000, 2500, 3500):
                for pol in ("overwrite", "block", "drop"):
                    r = run("1080p", L, pol, "busy", stall, 3.0, 8.0)
                    out["part_a"].append(r)
                    pcm.write_json(out_path, out)
                    print(f"A L={L} stall={stall} {pol}: produced {r['produced_total']} recorded {r['recorded_total']} "
                          f"recorder_lost {r['recorder_lost_total']} ring_full_drops {r['ring_full_drops_total']} "
                          f"sensor_skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} blocked_max {r['blocked_s_max']:.2f}s maxlag {r['max_lag_slots']} "
                          f"consecutive {r['all_consecutive']}", flush=True)
    if "B" in parts:
        out["part_b"] = []
        for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
            L = 172 if size_name == "1080p" else 388
            r = run(size_name, L, "block", "msmf", 1500, 8.0, 20.0)
            out["part_b"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json(out_path, out)
            print(f"B {size_name} L={L}: produced {r['produced_total']} recorded {r['recorded_total']} lost {r['recorder_lost_total']} "
                  f"sensor_skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} maxlag {r['max_lag_slots']} files "
                  f"{[(f['decoded_frames'], f['expected'], f['content_ambiguous_or_torn']) for f in r['files']]} cpu {r['cpu'] and r['cpu']['sum_processes']:.0f}%",
                  flush=True)
    write_md(out)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)


def write_md(out):
    import proto_common as pcm
    L = ["# P3 - lossless record path (decoupled recorder, gated cursor) vs current overwrite policy", "",
         "## A. Stall-tolerance sweep: 5 cameras 1080p @60 fps, 5 recorders (2 ms synthetic work), one simultaneous stall at t=3 s, 8 s runs", "",
         "Totals over 5 cameras. `recorder lost` = frames the recorder never got (lapped; overwrite policy). `ring-full drops` = frames the "
         "camera explicitly skipped (drop policy). `sensor skipped` = sensor ticks never grabbed (includes block-policy back-pressure; "
         "~0-5 per run is scheduler noise).", "",
         "| L (s @60) | stall ms | policy | produced | recorded | recorder lost (silent today) | ring-full drops (explicit) | sensor skipped | max blocked s | max lag slots | consecutive | lossless after ring |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in out.get("part_a", []):
        L.append(f"| {r['L']} ({r['ring_seconds_at_60fps']:.2f}) | {r['stall_ms']} | {r['policy']} | {r['produced_total']} | {r['recorded_total']} | "
                 f"{r['recorder_lost_total']} | {r['ring_full_drops_total']} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | {r['blocked_s_max']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['max_lag_slots']} | {r['all_consecutive']} | {r['lossless_on_disk_path']} |")
    L += ["", "## B. Real encoder (cv2 'X264' -> MSMF H.264) as a decoupled recorder, block policy, 20 s, one 1500 ms stall at t=8 s", "",
          "| size | L | produced | recorded | lost | sensor skipped | max lag slots | lag p99 (worst cam) | write() median / p99 / max ms (worst cam) | tick->written median / p99 ms | files decoded == produced | content torn/ambiguous | release s | CPU sum % (cams+recorders) |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in out.get("part_b", []):
        wr = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["write"]["p99_ms"])
        tw = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["tick_to_written"]["p99_ms"])
        files_ok = all(f["decoded_frames"] == f["expected"] for f in r["files"])
        L.append(f"| {r['size']} | {r['L']} | {r['produced_total']} | {r['recorded_total']} | {r['recorder_lost_total']} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | "
                 f"{r['max_lag_slots']} | {max(x['lag_p99_slots'] for x in r['recorders']):.0f} | {wr['write']['median_ms']:.2f} / {wr['write']['p99_ms']:.2f} / {wr['write']['max_ms']:.2f} | "
                 f"{tw['tick_to_written']['median_ms']:.1f} / {tw['tick_to_written']['p99_ms']:.1f} | {files_ok} "
                 f"({[f['decoded_frames'] for f in r['files']]}) | {sum(f['content_ambiguous_or_torn'] for f in r['files'])} of {sum(f['content_checked'] for f in r['files'])} | "
                 f"{max(x['release_s'] for x in r['recorders']):.2f} | {r['cpu']['sum_processes'] if r['cpu'] else float('nan'):.0f} |")
    pcm.write_text("p3_lossless_record.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""P4 - MJPEG passthrough recording vs decode + re-encode, with the decoupled gated recorder from P3.

Simulated MJPEG camera: synthetic frames (baseline synthetic_frames, noise=8) pre-encoded with cv2.imencode q90
(30 distinct frames cycled) - the bytes a UVC camera would deliver. 5 spawned camera processes (FakeSensor 60 fps,
latest-frame-wins) + 5 spawned recorder processes, each recorder with its own gated cursor (block policy).

  passthrough : camera copies the JPEG bytes into a byte-slot SeqRing (slot = 1 MiB; 1 compressed copy);
                recorder wraps the slot VIEW in av.Packet (1 compressed copy, inside PyAV) and muxes it into .mkv
                with the sensor tick time as pts (ms). No decode, no encode.
  decode_msmf : camera cv2.imdecode -> np.copyto(BGR slot) (what a camera path must do to get pixels);
                recorder cv2.VideoWriter('X264') -> MSMF H.264 (SkellyCam's default writer on this machine) fed the view.
  passthrough_unthrottled : no sensor pacing; camera publishes as fast as the gated recorder allows (5 s) -> max mux rate.

Metrics: per-camera achieved fps, sensor frames never grabbed, frames recorded, frames decoded back from each file,
disk bytes/s, CPU% (psutil, per process, averaged over the run), CPU ms per frame, tick->written latency.

Run (from C:\\Users\\Dom\\GitHub\\freemocap\\skellycam): .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p4_mjpeg_passthrough.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

N_CAMS = 5
FPS = 60.0
RUN_S = float(os.environ.get("P4_RUN_S", "20"))


def camera(spec, cam, h, w, mode, run_s, ready_q, go, out_q):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    cv2.setNumThreads(1)
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    jpegs = [cv2.imencode(".jpg", f, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 90])[1] for f in frames]
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go.wait()
    paced = not mode.endswith("unthrottled")
    sensor = pcm.FakeSensor(FPS, seed=cam)
    k = 0
    blocked = 0.0
    t_end = time.perf_counter_ns() + int(run_s * 1e9)
    cpu0 = time.process_time()
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    work = []
    while time.perf_counter_ns() < t_end:
        if paced:
            tick, t_tick = sensor.grab()
        else:
            tick, t_tick = k, time.perf_counter_ns()
        if not ring.can_write(k, 1):
            b0 = time.perf_counter()
            while not ring.can_write(k, 1):
                time.sleep(0.0002)
            blocked += time.perf_counter() - b0
        t0 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        s = ring.begin(k)
        j = jpegs[tick % 30]
        if mode.startswith("passthrough"):
            n = j.size
            ring.bytes_view(s, n)[:] = j  # the one compressed copy into shm
        else:
            n = h * w * 3
            np.copyto(ring.image_view(s, (h, w, 3)), cv2.imdecode(j, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR))
        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=t_tick, nbytes=n, aux0=tick)
        work.append(time.perf_counter_ns() - t0)
        k += 1
    el = time.perf_counter() - t_start
    cpu = time.process_time() - cpu0
    out_q.put(dict(cam=cam, produced=k, fps=k / el, sensor_skipped=sensor.skipped if paced else None, blocked_s=blocked,
                   work=pcm.stats_ms(work), cpu_ms_per_frame=1000 * cpu / max(k, 1), cpu_pct=100 * cpu / el))
    ring.close()


def recorder(spec, cam, h, w, mode, path, ready_q, go, stop, out_q):
    import cv2
    import av
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    if mode.startswith("passthrough"):
        c = av.open(str(path), "w")
        st = c.add_stream("mjpeg", rate=60)
        st.width, st.height = w, h
        st.pix_fmt = "yuvj420p"
        tb = Fraction(1, 1000)
        vw = None
    else:
        vw = cv2.VideoWriter(str(path), cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"X264"), FPS, (w, h))
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go.wait()
    nxt = 0
    t_first = None
    fns = []
    lat = []
    wlat = []
    nbytes = 0
    cpu0 = time.process_time()
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    while True:
        hd = ring.head
        if nxt > hd:
            if stop.is_set() and ring.head < nxt:
                break
            time.sleep(0.0003)
            continue
        sl = nxt % ring.L
        m = ring.meta[sl]
        t_tick = int(m[pcm.F_TICK])
        if t_first is None:
            t_first = t_tick
        t0 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        if vw is None:
            n = int(m[pcm.F_NBYTES])
            pkt = av.Packet(ring.bytes_view(sl, n))
            pkt.stream = st
            pkt.time_base = tb
            pkt.pts = pkt.dts = (t_tick - t_first) // 1_000_000
            c.mux(pkt)
            nbytes += n
        else:
            vw.write(ring.image_view(sl, (h, w, 3)))
        t1 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        fns.append(int(m[pcm.F_FN]))
        lat.append(t1 - t_tick)
        wlat.append(t1 - t0)
        ring.set_cursor(0, nxt)
        nxt += 1
    loop_s = time.perf_counter() - t_start
    r0 = time.perf_counter()
    if vw is None:
        c.close()
    else:
        vw.release()
    rel = time.perf_counter() - r0
    cpu = time.process_time() - cpu0
    out_q.put(dict(cam=cam, recorded=len(fns), consecutive=bool(len(fns) < 2 or np.all(np.diff(fns) == 1)),
                   tick_to_written=pcm.stats_ms(lat), write=pcm.stats_ms(wlat), release_s=rel, loop_s=loop_s,
                   cpu_ms_per_frame=1000 * cpu / max(len(fns), 1), cpu_pct=100 * cpu / (loop_s + rel),
                   compressed_bytes_muxed=nbytes))
    ring.close()


def run(size_name, mode, run_s):
    import proto_common as pcm
    h, w = pcm.SIZES[size_name]
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    if mode.startswith("passthrough"):
        L, slot = 1024, 1 << 20  # 1 GiB of 1 MiB slots = 17 s at 60 fps
    else:
        L, slot = (1024 ** 3) // (632 + h * w * 3), h * w * 3
    rings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(L, slot, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
    ext = "mkv" if mode.startswith("passthrough") else "mp4"
    paths = [pcm.SCRATCH_TMP / f"p4_{size_name}_{mode}_cam{i}.{ext}" for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    ready_q, oc, orr = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue(), ctx.Queue()
    go, stop = ctx.Event(), ctx.Event()
    cams = [ctx.Process(target=camera, args=(rings[i].spec(), i, h, w, mode, run_s, ready_q, go, oc)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    recs = [ctx.Process(target=recorder, args=(rings[i].spec(), i, h, w, mode, paths[i], ready_q, go, stop, orr)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
    for p in cams + recs:
        p.start()
    for _ in cams + recs:
        ready_q.get(timeout=300)
    samples = []
    cs = threading.Event()
    th = threading.Thread(target=pcm.cpu_sampler, args=([p.pid for p in cams + recs], cs, samples), daemon=True)
    th.start()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    go.set()
    cres = sorted([oc.get(timeout=run_s + 120) for _ in cams], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    stop.set()
    rres = sorted([orr.get(timeout=300) for _ in recs], key=lambda r: r["cam"])
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
    cs.set()
    for p in cams + recs:
        p.join(30)
    for r in rings:
        r.close()
    cpu = pcm.summarize_cpu(samples)
    cam_pids = {str(p.pid) for p in cams}
    rec_pids = {str(p.pid) for p in recs}
    cpu_split = None
    if cpu:
        cpu_split = dict(cameras=sum(v for k, v in cpu.items() if k in cam_pids),
                         recorders=sum(v for k, v in cpu.items() if k in rec_pids), system=cpu["system"])
    files = []
    for i, p in enumerate(paths):
        files.append(dict(file=p.name, bytes=p.stat().st_size, decoded_frames=pcm.count_video_frames(p),
                          produced=cres[i]["produced"], recorded=rres[i]["recorded"]))
    for p in paths:
        p.unlink()
    total_bytes = sum(f["bytes"] for f in files)
    rec_s = max(c["produced"] for c in cres) / FPS if not mode.endswith("unthrottled") else run_s
    return dict(size=size_name, mode=mode, run_s=run_s, ring_len=L, ring_slot_bytes=slot, ring_seconds=L / FPS,
                cameras=cres, recorders=rres, files=files, cpu_psutil_mean=cpu, cpu_split=cpu_split, wall_s=wall,
                min_cam_fps=min(c["fps"] for c in cres), sensor_skipped_total=sum((c["sensor_skipped"] or 0) for c in cres),
                files_equal_produced=all(f["decoded_frames"] == f["produced"] for f in files),
                disk_MBps_5cams=total_bytes / rec_s / 1e6, disk_bytes_total=total_bytes,
                cam_cpu_ms_per_frame=float(np.median([c["cpu_ms_per_frame"] for c in cres])),
                rec_cpu_ms_per_frame=float(np.median([r["cpu_ms_per_frame"] for r in rres])),
                recorder_fps_unthrottled=(sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres) / run_s) if mode.endswith("unthrottled") else None)


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), rows=[])
    for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
        for mode in ("passthrough", "decode_msmf", "passthrough_unthrottled"):
            r = run(size_name, mode, 5.0 if mode.endswith("unthrottled") else RUN_S)
            out["rows"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json("p4_mjpeg_passthrough.json", out)
            print(f"{size_name} {mode}: min fps {r['min_cam_fps']:.2f} skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} files==produced {r['files_equal_produced']} "
                  f"disk {r['disk_MBps_5cams']:.1f} MB/s cpu {r['cpu_split']} cam {r['cam_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} rec {r['rec_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} ms/f "
                  f"unthr {r['recorder_fps_unthrottled']}", flush=True)
    L = ["# P4 - MJPEG passthrough recording vs decode + MSMF H.264 re-encode (5 cameras, decoupled gated recorders)", "",
         f"Paced rows: 60 fps FakeSensor, {RUN_S}s. Unthrottled rows: 5 s, camera publishes as fast as the gated recorder consumes. "
         "CPU %: psutil mean per process over the run, 100 = one logical CPU; ms/frame from process_time.", "",
         "| size | mode | per-cam fps (min) | sensor frames never grabbed | files decode == produced | disk MB/s (5 cams) | CPU % cameras / recorders (sum) | camera CPU ms/frame | recorder CPU ms/frame | tick->written median / p99 ms (worst cam) | recorder release s | full-frame copies | unthrottled recorder fps (aggregate) |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    copies = {"passthrough": "0 (2 compressed copies)", "passthrough_unthrottled": "0 (2 compressed copies)",
              "decode_msmf": "1 after decode (+ encoder-internal, unknown)"}
    for r in out["rows"]:
        tw = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["tick_to_written"]["p99_ms"])["tick_to_written"]
        cs = r["cpu_split"] or {}
        L.append(f"| {r['size']} | {r['mode']} | {r['min_cam_fps']:.2f} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | {r['files_equal_produced']} | "
                 f"{r['disk_MBps_5cams']:.1f} | {cs.get('cameras', float('nan')):.0f} / {cs.get('recorders', float('nan')):.0f} | "
                 f"{r['cam_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} | {r['rec_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} | {tw['median_ms']:.1f} / {tw['p99_ms']:.1f} | "
                 f"{max(x['release_s'] for x in r['recorders']):.2f} | {copies[r['mode']]} | "
                 f"{'' if r['recorder_fps_unthrottled'] is None else f'{r['recorder_fps_unthrottled']:.0f}'} |")
    L += ["", "Baseline (baseline/results/c_record.md): real VideoRecorder in the camera loop, 5x1080p paced 60: summed process CPU 1169%; "
          "5x720p: 380%. Unthrottled cv2 X264->MSMF throughput (derived) about 116 fps/camera at 5x1080p."]
    pcm.write_text("p4_mjpeg_passthrough.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    stop.set()
    rres = sorted([orr.get(timeout=300) for _ in recs], key=lambda r: r["cam"])

                rec_cpu_ms_per_frame=float(np.median([r["cpu_ms_per_frame"] for r in rres])),
                recorder_fps_unthrottled=(sum(r["recorded"] for r in rres) / run_s) if mode.endswith("unthrottled") else None)


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), rows=[])
    for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
        for mode in ("passthrough", "decode_msmf", "passthrough_unthrottled"):
            r = run(size_name, mode, 5.0 if mode.endswith("unthrottled") else RUN_S)
            out["rows"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json("p4_mjpeg_passthrough.json", out)
            print(f"{size_name} {mode}: min fps {r['min_cam_fps']:.2f} skipped {r['sensor_skipped_total']} files==produced {r['files_equal_produced']} "
                  f"disk {r['disk_MBps_5cams']:.1f} MB/s cpu {r['cpu_split']} cam {r['cam_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} rec {r['rec_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} ms/f "
                  f"unthr {r['recorder_fps_unthrottled']}", flush=True)
    L = ["# P4 - MJPEG passthrough recording vs decode + MSMF H.264 re-encode (5 cameras, decoupled gated recorders)", "",
         f"Paced rows: 60 fps FakeSensor, {RUN_S}s. Unthrottled rows: 5 s, camera publishes as fast as the gated recorder consumes. "
         "CPU %: psutil mean per process over the run, 100 = one logical CPU; ms/frame from process_time.", "",
         "| size | mode | per-cam fps (min) | sensor frames never grabbed | files decode == produced | disk MB/s (5 cams) | CPU % cameras / recorders (sum) | camera CPU ms/frame | recorder CPU ms/frame | tick->written median / p99 ms (worst cam) | recorder release s | full-frame copies | unthrottled recorder fps (aggregate) |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    copies = {"passthrough": "0 (2 compressed copies)", "passthrough_unthrottled": "0 (2 compressed copies)",
              "decode_msmf": "1 after decode (+ encoder-internal, unknown)"}
    for r in out["rows"]:
        tw = max(r["recorders"], key=lambda x: x["tick_to_written"]["p99_ms"])["tick_to_written"]
        cs = r["cpu_split"] or {}
        L.append(f"| {r['size']} | {r['mode']} | {r['min_cam_fps']:.2f} | {r['sensor_skipped_total']} | {r['files_equal_produced']} | "
                 f"{r['disk_MBps_5cams']:.1f} | {cs.get('cameras', float('nan')):.0f} / {cs.get('recorders', float('nan')):.0f} | "
                 f"{r['cam_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} | {r['rec_cpu_ms_per_frame']:.3f} | {tw['median_ms']:.1f} / {tw['p99_ms']:.1f} | "
                 f"{max(x['release_s'] for x in r['recorders']):.2f} | {copies[r['mode']]} | "
                 f"{'' if r['recorder_fps_unthrottled'] is None else f'{r['recorder_fps_unthrottled']:.0f}'} |")
    L += ["", "Baseline (baseline/results/c_record.md): real VideoRecorder in the camera loop, 5x1080p paced 60: summed process CPU 1169%; "
          "5x720p: 380%. Unthrottled cv2 X264->MSMF throughput (derived) about 116 fps/camera at 5x1080p."]
    pcm.write_text("p4_mjpeg_passthrough.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)

"""P5 - hardware encode (NVENC via PyAV 18 / FFmpeg) fed from shared memory vs the current software-path writer.

Part S - NVENC session limit: one process opens N concurrent PyAV encoders (h264_nvenc, then hevc_nvenc) at 1280x720,
each encoding one frame and staying open, N = 1..MAX_SESSIONS, until opening/encoding fails. nvidia-smi
encoder.stats.sessionCount is sampled while all are open.

Part E - 5 spawned camera processes (FakeSensor 60 fps; pixels = np.copyto(synthetic frame) into a BGR SeqRing slot,
i.e. the decode-free memcpy stand-in so only the encoder differs) + 5 spawned recorder processes (gated cursor,
block policy). Recorder encoders:
  msmf        : cv2.VideoWriter('X264') -> MSMF H.264 (SkellyCam's default on this machine), write(slot view)
  h264_nvenc  : cv2.cvtColor(slot view, BGR2YUV_I420, dst=preallocated) -> av.VideoFrame.from_ndarray(yuv420p)
                -> h264_nvenc (preset p4, tune ll, rc vbr, cq 23) -> mp4
  hevc_nvenc  : same, hevc_nvenc cq 25
Paced: 60 fps, RUN_S s, 1080p and 720p. Unthrottled: 900 frames per camera as fast as the gated chain allows.
Full-frame-equivalent copies on the NVENC path: BGR->I420 conversion (writes 1.5 B/px), from_ndarray copy of the I420
buffer (1.5 B/px), then the host->GPU upload inside NVENC (not measurable here).

Run (from C:\\Users\\Dom\\GitHub\\freemocap\\skellycam): .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p5_nvenc.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

N_CAMS = 5
FPS = 60.0
RUN_S = float(os.environ.get("P5_RUN_S", "20"))
UNTHROTTLED_FRAMES = 900
MAX_SESSIONS = 20
NVENC_OPTS = {"h264_nvenc": {"preset": "p4", "tune": "ll", "rc": "vbr", "cq": "23"},
              "hevc_nvenc": {"preset": "p4", "tune": "ll", "rc": "vbr", "cq": "25"}}


def nvsmi_sessions():
    try:
        o = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=encoder.stats.sessionCount", "--format=csv,noheader"], text=True)
        return int(o.strip().splitlines()[0])
    except Exception as e:
        return repr(e)


def session_probe(codec):
    import av
    h, w = 720, 1280
    img = np.zeros((h * 3 // 2, w), np.uint8)
    open_ = []
    err = None
    for n in range(1, MAX_SESSIONS + 1):
        try:
            cc = av.CodecContext.create(codec, "w")
            cc.width, cc.height, cc.pix_fmt = w, h, "yuv420p"
            from fractions import Fraction
            cc.time_base = Fraction(1, 60)
            cc.options = NVENC_OPTS[codec]
            cc.open()
            f = av.VideoFrame.from_ndarray(img, format="yuv420p"); f.pts = 0
            cc.encode(f)
            open_.append(cc)
        except Exception as e:
            err = f"session {n}: {e!r}"
            break
    smi = nvsmi_sessions()
    ok = len(open_)
    for cc in open_:
        try:
            cc.encode(None)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            cc.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
    del open_
    return dict(codec=codec, max_concurrent_opened=ok, first_error=err, nvidia_smi_session_count_while_open=smi,
                probe_limit=MAX_SESSIONS)


def camera(spec, cam, h, w, paced, run_s, ready_q, go, out_q):
    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go.wait()
    sensor = pcm.FakeSensor(FPS, seed=cam)
    k = 0
    t_end = time.perf_counter_ns() + int(run_s * 1e9)
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    blocked = 0.0
    while time.perf_counter_ns() < t_end and (paced or k < UNTHROTTLED_FRAMES):
        if paced:
            tick, t_tick = sensor.grab()
        else:
            tick, t_tick = k, time.perf_counter_ns()
        if not ring.can_write(k, 1):
            b0 = time.perf_counter()
            while not ring.can_write(k, 1):
                time.sleep(0.0002)
            blocked += time.perf_counter() - b0
        s = ring.begin(k)
        np.copyto(ring.image_view(s, (h, w, 3)), frames[tick % 30])
        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=t_tick, aux0=tick)
        k += 1
    el = time.perf_counter() - t_start
    out_q.put(dict(cam=cam, produced=k, fps=k / el, sensor_skipped=sensor.skipped if paced else None, blocked_s=blocked))
    ring.close()


def recorder(spec, cam, h, w, enc, path, ready_q, go, stop, out_q):
    import cv2
    import av
    import proto_common as pcm
    cv2.setNumThreads(2)
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    vw = c = st = None
    if enc == "msmf":
        vw = cv2.VideoWriter(str(path), cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"X264"), FPS, (w, h))
        backend = vw.getBackendName()
    else:
        c = av.open(str(path), "w")
        st = c.add_stream(enc, rate=60)
        st.width, st.height, st.pix_fmt = w, h, "yuv420p"
        st.options = NVENC_OPTS[enc]
        backend = enc
        i420 = np.empty((h * 3 // 2, w), np.uint8)
    ready_q.put(cam)
    go.wait()
    nxt = 0
    fns, lat, wlat, conv = [], [], [], []
    cpu0 = time.process_time()
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    while True:
        if nxt > ring.head:
            if stop.is_set() and ring.head < nxt:
                break
            time.sleep(0.0003)
            continue
        sl = nxt % ring.L
        view = ring.image_view(sl, (h, w, 3))
        t0 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        if vw is not None:
            vw.write(view)
            t_c = t0
        else:
            cv2.cvtColor(view, cv2.COLOR_BGR2YUV_I420, dst=i420)
            t_c = time.perf_counter_ns()
            f = av.VideoFrame.from_ndarray(i420, format="yuv420p")
            f.pts = nxt
            for pk in st.encode(f):
                c.mux(pk)
        t1 = time.perf_counter_ns()
        fns.append(int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_FN]))
        lat.append(t1 - int(ring.meta[sl, pcm.F_TICK]))
        wlat.append(t1 - t0)
        conv.append(t_c - t0)
        ring.set_cursor(0, nxt)  # slot released only after the encoder call has consumed it
        nxt += 1
    loop_s = time.perf_counter() - t_start

Full-frame-equivalent copies on the NVENC path: BGR->I420 conversion (writes 1.5 B/px), from_ndarray copy of the I420

import multiprocessing as mp

import sys

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

N_CAMS = 5
FPS = 60.0
RUN_S = float(os.environ.get("P6_RUN_S", "10"))
META = 632

    except Exception:

def writer(spec, jspec, cam, h, w, ready_q, stop):

    import proto_common as pcm
    ring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(spec)
    jring = pcm.SeqRing.attach(jspec)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=cam, noise=8)
    jpegs = [cv2.imencode(".jpg", f, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 90])[1] for f in frames]
    n = h * w * 3
    sensor = pcm.FakeSensor(FPS, seed=cam)
    ready_q.put(cam)
    k = 0
    while not stop.is_set():
        tick, t = sensor.grab()

        ring.commit(k, s, frame_number=k, tick_ns=t)

        jring.bytes_view(s2, j.size)[:] = j

class Builder:
    def __init__(self, rings, jrings, h, w, variant):
        import cv2
        self.cv2 = cv2
        self.rings, self.jrings, self.h, self.w, self.v = rings, jrings, h, w, variant
        self.n = h * w * 3
        tw, th = (640, 360) if variant == "view_proto_640x360" else (w // 2, h // 2)
        self.tw, self.th = tw, th
        self.small = [np.empty((th, tw, 3), np.uint8) for _ in rings]
        self.out = [bytearray(16 << 20), bytearray(16 << 20)]  # double-buffered per-connection payload buffers
        self.flip = 0
        self.last_heads = [-1] * len(rings)
        self.pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(len(rings)) if variant == "view_proto_threads" else None
        self.rec = None
        if variant in ("cur_copy_real", "view_real"):
            import bench_common as bc
            from skellycam.core.types.frame_dtype_factories import create_frame_dtype
            from skellycam.core.types.frontend_payload_bytearray import create_frontend_payload
            self.cfp = create_frontend_payload
            self.cfgs = [bc.make_config(i, h, w) for i in range(len(rings))]
            self.dtype = create_frame_dtype(self.cfgs[0])
            assert self.dtype.itemsize == META + self.n, (self.dtype.itemsize, META + self.n)
            self.priv = {str(i): bc.make_frame_recarray(self.cfgs[i]) for i in range(len(rings))}
            # metadata template so the views carry valid camera_info
            for i, r in enumerate(rings):
                for s in range(r.L):
                    r.payload[s, :META] = self.priv[str(i)].view(np.uint8)[:META]
        if variant == "view_simplejpeg":
            import simplejpeg
            self.sj = simplejpeg
        self.copies = 0

    def heads(self):
        return [r.head for r in self.rings]

    def _acquire(self):
        ks = self.heads()
        seqs = [int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) for r, k in zip(self.rings, ks)]
        return ks, seqs

    def _valid(self, ks, seqs):
        return all(s == 2 * k + 2 and int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) == s for r, k, s in zip(self.rings, ks, seqs))

    def _img(self, i, k):
        r = self.rings[i]
        return r.payload[k % r.L, META:META + self.n].reshape(self.h, self.w, 3)

    def _encode_one(self, i, k):
        cv2 = self.cv2
        if self.v.startswith("jpeg_"):
            jr = self.jrings[i]
            sl = k % jr.L
            jb = jr.bytes_view(sl, int(jr.meta[sl, 4]))
            if self.v == "jpeg_forward":
                return jb
            red = cv2.imdecode(jb, cv2.IMREAD_REDUCED_COLOR_2)
            return cv2.imencode(".jpg", red, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 60])[1]
        cv2.resize(self._img(i, k), (self.tw, self.th), dst=self.small[i], interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        if self.v == "view_simplejpeg":
            return self.sj.encode_jpeg(self.small[i], quality=60, colorspace="BGR")
        return cv2.imencode(".jpg", self.small[i], [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 60])[1]

    async def build(self, loop):
        """returns (payload_len or None if skipped, valid, distinct)"""
        v = self.v
        if v in ("cur_copy_real", "view_real"):
            ks = self.heads()
            k = min(ks)  # latest complete multiframe = min(last_written_index) as in camera_group_shared_memory.py L33-35
            seqs = [int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) for r in self.rings]
            frames = {}

                slot = r.payload[k % r.L, :META + self.n]
                recv = np.ndarray((1,), dtype=self.dtype, buffer=slot).view(np.recarray)

            valid = all(s == 2 * k + 2 and int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) == s for r, s in zip(self.rings, seqs))

            parts = await asyncio.gather(*[loop.run_in_executor(self.pool, self._encode_one, i, k) for i, k in enumerate(ks)])

            pos += 56

            pos += len(b)

        pos += 24
        self.last_heads = ks
        return pos, valid, True


async def run_variant(rings, jrings, h, w, variant):
    import proto_common as pcm
    b = Builder(rings, jrings, h, w, variant)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    lag = []
    stop = {"x": False}

    async def heartbeat():
        while not stop["x"]:
            t = time.perf_counter_ns()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
            lag.append(time.perf_counter_ns() - t)

    hb = asyncio.create_task(heartbeat())
    build_ns, sizes = [], []
    n_pay = n_distinct = n_skip = n_invalid = 0
    t_end = time.perf_counter() + RUN_S
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    cpu0 = time.process_time()
    while time.perf_counter() < t_end:
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        a = time.perf_counter_ns()
        size, valid, distinct = await b.build(loop)
        e = time.perf_counter_ns()
        if size is None:
            n_skip += 1
            continue
        build_ns.append(e - a); sizes.append(size)
        n_pay += 1
        n_distinct += int(distinct)
        n_invalid += int(not valid)
    el = time.perf_counter() - t0
    cpu = time.process_time() - cpu0
    stop["x"] = True
    await hb
    if b.pool:
        b.pool.shutdown()
    return dict(variant=variant, payloads_per_s=n_pay / el, distinct_per_s=n_distinct / el, skipped_no_new_frame=n_skip,
                invalid_seqlock=n_invalid, build=pcm.stats_ms(build_ns), payload_kb_median=float(np.median(sizes)) / 1e3 if sizes else None,
                loop_heartbeat_1ms=pcm.stats_ms(lag), main_cpu_pct=100 * cpu / el)

          "view_real": "0 out of shm; 5 resize outputs (alloc); JPEG x3",
          "view_proto": "0 out of shm; resize into preallocated dst; JPEG x1 (assemble)",
          "view_proto_640x360": "same as view_proto", "view_proto_threads": "same as view_proto",
          "view_simplejpeg": "same as view_proto", "jpeg_forward": "0 pixel copies; camera JPEG x1 (assemble)",
          "jpeg_reduced_reencode": "0 full-res frames; reduced decode + encode; JPEG x1"}


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    if "--summarize" in sys.argv:
        return summarize()
    sk, sj = have("skellycam"), have("simplejpeg")
    tag = "skellycamvenv" if sk else "benchvenv"
    variants = (["cur_copy_real", "view_real"] if sk else []) + ["view_proto", "view_proto_640x360", "view_proto_threads"] + \
               (["view_simplejpeg"] if sj else []) + ["jpeg_forward", "jpeg_reduced_reencode"]
    if not sk:
        variants = ["view_proto", "view_simplejpeg"]
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), run_s=RUN_S, rows=[])
    for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
        h, w = pcm.SIZES[size_name]
        L = (1024 ** 3) // (META + h * w * 3)
        rings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(L, META + h * w * 3, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
        jrings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(256, JPEG_SLOT, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
        rq, stop = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Event()
        procs = [ctx.Process(target=writer, args=(rings[i].spec(), jrings[i].spec(), i, h, w, rq, stop)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
        for p in procs:
            p.start()
        for _ in procs:
            rq.get(timeout=120)
        time.sleep(2.0)
        for v in variants:
            r = asyncio.run(run_variant(rings, jrings, h, w, v))
            r.update(size=size_name, venv=tag, copies=COPIES[v])
            out["rows"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json(f"p6_ui_{tag}.json", out)
            print(f"{size_name} {v}: {r['payloads_per_s']:.1f} payloads/s ({r['distinct_per_s']:.1f} distinct), build {r['build']['median_ms']:.2f}/"
                  f"{r['build']['p99_ms']:.2f} ms, loop hb p99 {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['p99_ms']:.2f} max {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['max_ms']:.2f} ms, "
                  f"{r['payload_kb_median']:.0f} KB, invalid {r['invalid_seqlock']}, cpu {r['main_cpu_pct']:.0f}%", flush=True)
        stop.set()
        for p in procs:
            p.join(30)
        for r in rings + jrings:
            r.close()
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)

    import json
    import proto_common as pcm
    rows = []
    for tag in ("skellycamvenv", "benchvenv"):
        p = pcm.RESULTS / f"p6_ui_{tag}.json"
        if p.exists():
            rows += json.loads(p.read_text())["rows"]
    L = ["# P6 - UI tap server-side build (5 cameras, 60 fps writers, relay-shaped 10 ms loop, instant ack, no browser)", "",
         f"{RUN_S}s per variant. `loop heartbeat` = actual duration of an `await asyncio.sleep(0.001)` task running beside the relay "
         "(how long the event loop that also serves HTTP control is blocked). CPU = main process only.", "",
         "| size | variant | venv | payloads/s | distinct/s | build median / p99 ms | loop heartbeat p99 / max ms | payload KB | seqlock invalid | main CPU % | copies |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in rows:

                 f"{r['build']['median_ms']:.2f} / {r['build']['p99_ms']:.2f} | {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['p99_ms']:.2f} / {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['max_ms']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['payload_kb_median']:.0f} | {r['invalid_seqlock']} | {r['main_cpu_pct']:.0f} | {r['copies']} |")
    L += ["", "Baseline (baseline/results/d_ui.md, real SkellyCam ring + get_latest_multiframe + create_frontend_payload): 1080p 43.7 payloads/s, "
          "total 10.90 ms median / 23.76 p99; 720p 59.9 payloads/s, 6.28 ms. FreeMoCap by-number path 1080p 37.9/s, 15.43 ms.",
          "Note: jpeg_forward payload size reflects the synthetic q90 JPEGs (~540 KB at 1080p); real cameras measured ~160-167 KB/frame "
          "(research: c922 720p60, C930e 1080p30)."]
    pcm.write_text("p6_ui_path.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")

        self.pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(len(rings)) if variant == "view_proto_threads" else None
        self.rec = None
        if variant in ("cur_copy_real", "view_real"):
            import bench_common as bc
            from skellycam.core.types.frame_dtype_factories import create_frame_dtype
            from skellycam.core.types.frontend_payload_bytearray import create_frontend_payload
            self.cfp = create_frontend_payload
            self.cfgs = [bc.make_config(i, h, w) for i in range(len(rings))]
            self.dtype = create_frame_dtype(self.cfgs[0])
            assert self.dtype.itemsize == META + self.n, (self.dtype.itemsize, META + self.n)
            self.priv = {str(i): bc.make_frame_recarray(self.cfgs[i]) for i in range(len(rings))}
            # metadata template so the views carry valid camera_info
            for i, r in enumerate(rings):
                for s in range(r.L):
                    r.payload[s, :META] = self.priv[str(i)].view(np.uint8)[:META]
        if variant == "view_simplejpeg":
            import simplejpeg
            self.sj = simplejpeg
        self.copies = 0

    def heads(self):
        return [r.head for r in self.rings]

    def _acquire(self):
        ks = self.heads()
        seqs = [int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) for r, k in zip(self.rings, ks)]
        return ks, seqs

    def _valid(self, ks, seqs):
        return all(s == 2 * k + 2 and int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) == s for r, k, s in zip(self.rings, ks, seqs))

    def _img(self, i, k):
        r = self.rings[i]
        return r.payload[k % r.L, META:META + self.n].reshape(self.h, self.w, 3)

    def _encode_one(self, i, k):
        cv2 = self.cv2
        if self.v.startswith("jpeg_"):
            jr = self.jrings[i]
            sl = k % jr.L
            jb = jr.bytes_view(sl, int(jr.meta[sl, 4]))
            if self.v == "jpeg_forward":
                return jb
            red = cv2.imdecode(jb, cv2.IMREAD_REDUCED_COLOR_2)
            return cv2.imencode(".jpg", red, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 60])[1]
        cv2.resize(self._img(i, k), (self.tw, self.th), dst=self.small[i], interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        if self.v == "view_simplejpeg":
            return self.sj.encode_jpeg(self.small[i], quality=60, colorspace="BGR")
        return cv2.imencode(".jpg", self.small[i], [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 60])[1]

    async def build(self, loop):
        """returns (payload_len or None if skipped, valid, distinct)"""
        v = self.v
        if v in ("cur_copy_real", "view_real"):
            ks = self.heads()
            k = min(ks)  # latest complete multiframe = min(last_written_index) as in camera_group_shared_memory.py L33-35
            seqs = [int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) for r in self.rings]
            frames = {}
            for i, r in enumerate(self.rings):
                slot = r.payload[k % r.L, :META + self.n]
                recv = np.ndarray((1,), dtype=self.dtype, buffer=slot).view(np.recarray)
                if v == "cur_copy_real":
                    np.copyto(self.priv[str(i)], recv)  # get_data_by_index's np.copyto into a reused recarray
                    frames[str(i)] = self.priv[str(i)]
                else:
                    frames[str(i)] = recv
            fn, ts, payload = self.cfp(frames, None)
            valid = all(s == 2 * k + 2 and int(r.meta[k % r.L, 0]) == s for r, s in zip(self.rings, seqs))
            distinct = k != self.last_heads[0]
            self.last_heads = [k] * len(self.rings)
            return len(payload), valid, distinct
        ks, seqs = self._acquire()
        if all(k == lk for k, lk in zip(ks, self.last_heads)):
            return None, True, False  # latest-frame-wins: nothing new -> no work
        if self.pool is not None:
            parts = await asyncio.gather(*[loop.run_in_executor(self.pool, self._encode_one, i, k) for i, k in enumerate(ks)])
        else:
            parts = [self._encode_one(i, k) for i, k in enumerate(ks)]
        valid = self._valid(ks, seqs) if not v.startswith("jpeg_") else all(
            int(jr.meta[k % jr.L, 0]) == 2 * k + 2 for jr, k in zip(self.jrings, ks))
        buf = self.out[self.flip]
        self.flip ^= 1
        mv = memoryview(buf)
        pos = 24
        for p in parts:
            b = memoryview(p).cast("B") if not isinstance(p, (bytes, bytearray)) else memoryview(p)
            mv[pos:pos + 56] = b"\0" * 56
            pos += 56
            mv[pos:pos + len(b)] = b
            pos += len(b)
        mv[pos:pos + 24] = b"\0" * 24
        pos += 24
        self.last_heads = ks
        return pos, valid, True


async def run_variant(rings, jrings, h, w, variant):
    import proto_common as pcm
    b = Builder(rings, jrings, h, w, variant)
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    lag = []
    stop = {"x": False}

    async def heartbeat():
        while not stop["x"]:
            t = time.perf_counter_ns()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
            lag.append(time.perf_counter_ns() - t)

    hb = asyncio.create_task(heartbeat())
    build_ns, sizes = [], []
    n_pay = n_distinct = n_skip = n_invalid = 0
    t_end = time.perf_counter() + RUN_S
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    cpu0 = time.process_time()
    while time.perf_counter() < t_end:
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        a = time.perf_counter_ns()
        size, valid, distinct = await b.build(loop)
        e = time.perf_counter_ns()
        if size is None:
            n_skip += 1
            continue
        build_ns.append(e - a); sizes.append(size)
        n_pay += 1
        n_distinct += int(distinct)
        n_invalid += int(not valid)
    el = time.perf_counter() - t0
    cpu = time.process_time() - cpu0
    stop["x"] = True
    await hb
    if b.pool:
        b.pool.shutdown()
    return dict(variant=variant, payloads_per_s=n_pay / el, distinct_per_s=n_distinct / el, skipped_no_new_frame=n_skip,
                invalid_seqlock=n_invalid, build=pcm.stats_ms(build_ns), payload_kb_median=float(np.median(sizes)) / 1e3 if sizes else None,
                loop_heartbeat_1ms=pcm.stats_ms(lag), main_cpu_pct=100 * cpu / el)


COPIES = {"cur_copy_real": "5 full frames out of shm + 5 resize outputs (alloc) + JPEG x3 (tobytes, assemble, slice)",
          "view_real": "0 out of shm; 5 resize outputs (alloc); JPEG x3",
          "view_proto": "0 out of shm; resize into preallocated dst; JPEG x1 (assemble)",
          "view_proto_640x360": "same as view_proto", "view_proto_threads": "same as view_proto",
          "view_simplejpeg": "same as view_proto", "jpeg_forward": "0 pixel copies; camera JPEG x1 (assemble)",
          "jpeg_reduced_reencode": "0 full-res frames; reduced decode + encode; JPEG x1"}


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    if "--summarize" in sys.argv:
        return summarize()
    sk, sj = have("skellycam"), have("simplejpeg")
    tag = "skellycamvenv" if sk else "benchvenv"
    variants = (["cur_copy_real", "view_real"] if sk else []) + ["view_proto", "view_proto_640x360", "view_proto_threads"] + \
               (["view_simplejpeg"] if sj else []) + ["jpeg_forward", "jpeg_reduced_reencode"]
    if not sk:
        variants = ["view_proto", "view_simplejpeg"]
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), run_s=RUN_S, rows=[])
    for size_name in ("1080p", "720p"):
        h, w = pcm.SIZES[size_name]
        L = (1024 ** 3) // (META + h * w * 3)
        rings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(L, META + h * w * 3, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
        jrings = [pcm.SeqRing.create(256, JPEG_SLOT, prefault=True) for _ in range(N_CAMS)]
        rq, stop = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Event()
        procs = [ctx.Process(target=writer, args=(rings[i].spec(), jrings[i].spec(), i, h, w, rq, stop)) for i in range(N_CAMS)]
        for p in procs:
            p.start()
        for _ in procs:
            rq.get(timeout=120)
        time.sleep(2.0)
        for v in variants:
            r = asyncio.run(run_variant(rings, jrings, h, w, v))
            r.update(size=size_name, venv=tag, copies=COPIES[v])
            out["rows"].append(r)
            pcm.write_json(f"p6_ui_{tag}.json", out)
            print(f"{size_name} {v}: {r['payloads_per_s']:.1f} payloads/s ({r['distinct_per_s']:.1f} distinct), build {r['build']['median_ms']:.2f}/"
                  f"{r['build']['p99_ms']:.2f} ms, loop hb p99 {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['p99_ms']:.2f} max {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['max_ms']:.2f} ms, "
                  f"{r['payload_kb_median']:.0f} KB, invalid {r['invalid_seqlock']}, cpu {r['main_cpu_pct']:.0f}%", flush=True)
        stop.set()
        for p in procs:
            p.join(30)
        for r in rings + jrings:
            r.close()
    sys.stdout.flush()
    os._exit(0)


def summarize():
    import json
    import proto_common as pcm
    rows = []
    for tag in ("skellycamvenv", "benchvenv"):
        p = pcm.RESULTS / f"p6_ui_{tag}.json"
        if p.exists():
            rows += json.loads(p.read_text())["rows"]
    L = ["# P6 - UI tap server-side build (5 cameras, 60 fps writers, relay-shaped 10 ms loop, instant ack, no browser)", "",
         f"{RUN_S}s per variant. `loop heartbeat` = actual duration of an `await asyncio.sleep(0.001)` task running beside the relay "
         "(how long the event loop that also serves HTTP control is blocked). CPU = main process only.", "",

         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in rows:
        L.append(f"| {r['size']} | {r['variant']} | {r['venv']} | {r['payloads_per_s']:.1f} | {r['distinct_per_s']:.1f} | "
                 f"{r['build']['median_ms']:.2f} / {r['build']['p99_ms']:.2f} | {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['p99_ms']:.2f} / {r['loop_heartbeat_1ms']['max_ms']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['payload_kb_median']:.0f} | {r['invalid_seqlock']} | {r['main_cpu_pct']:.0f} | {r['copies']} |")
    L += ["", "Baseline (baseline/results/d_ui.md, real SkellyCam ring + get_latest_multiframe + create_frontend_payload): 1080p 43.7 payloads/s, "
          "total 10.90 ms median / 23.76 p99; 720p 59.9 payloads/s, 6.28 ms. FreeMoCap by-number path 1080p 37.9/s, 15.43 ms.",
          "Note: jpeg_forward payload size reflects the synthetic q90 JPEGs (~540 KB at 1080p); real cameras measured ~160-167 KB/frame "
          "(research: c922 720p60, C930e 1080p30)."]
    pcm.write_text("p6_ui_path.md", "\n".join(L) + "\n")
    print("\n".join(L))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""P7 - process/thread topology: do 5 per-camera workers need 5 processes, or do 5 threads in one process scale?

Workloads (each worker = one "camera"; in-memory synthetic frames, unthrottled, 1920x1080):
  imdecode     : cv2.imdecode of the q90 JPEG (cv2.setNumThreads(1))                         300 frames/worker
  simplejpeg   : simplejpeg.decode_jpeg(buffer=preallocated) (bench venv only)               300
  msmf_write   : cv2.VideoWriter('X264') -> MSMF H.264, write()+release()                    300
  h264_nvenc   : cvtColor BGR->I420 (dst prealloc) + PyAV from_ndarray + h264_nvenc encode   300
  mjpeg_mux    : PyAV av.Packet(jpeg) + mux into .mkv                                         3000
  py_overhead  : the per-frame pure-Python control-plane work of a camera loop, approximated by 40 numpy scalar
                 reads/writes on an int64 view + 9 nested recarray timestamp writes (verified code map W27/CP10)  20000
Topologies: 1 worker alone; 5 threads in one process; 5 spawned processes. Reported: aggregate fps, slowest worker fps,
scaling vs 1 worker (5.0 = perfect), process CPU% (psutil, sum over the measuring processes).

Run: .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p7_topology.py
     benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\.venv-bench\\Scripts\\python.exe benchmarks\\frame_pipeline\\prototypes\\p7_topology.py simplejpeg
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

N = 5
FRAMES = {"imdecode": 300, "simplejpeg": 300, "msmf_write": 300, "h264_nvenc": 300, "mjpeg_mux": 3000, "py_overhead": 20000}


def prepare(work, h, w, seed):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    cv2.setNumThreads(1)
    frames = pcm.synthetic_frames(h, w, n=30, seed=seed, noise=8)
    jpegs = [cv2.imencode(".jpg", f, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), 90])[1] for f in frames]
    return frames, jpegs


def do_work(work, h, w, frames, jpegs, wid, tag):
    import cv2
    import proto_common as pcm
    n = FRAMES[work]
    path = pcm.SCRATCH_TMP / f"p7_{tag}_{work}_{wid}_{os.getpid()}"
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    if work == "imdecode":
        for i in range(n):
            cv2.imdecode(jpegs[i % 30], cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    elif work == "simplejpeg":
        import simplejpeg
        dst = np.empty((h, w, 3), np.uint8)
        jb = [j.tobytes() for j in jpegs]
        for i in range(n):
            simplejpeg.decode_jpeg(jb[i % 30], colorspace="BGR", buffer=dst)
    elif work == "msmf_write":
        p = str(path) + ".mp4"
        vw = cv2.VideoWriter(p, cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"X264"), 60, (w, h))
        for i in range(n):
            vw.write(frames[i % 30])
        vw.release()
        os.remove(p)
    elif work == "h264_nvenc":
        import av
        p = str(path) + ".mp4"
        c = av.open(p, "w")
        st = c.add_stream("h264_nvenc", rate=60)
        st.width, st.height, st.pix_fmt = w, h, "yuv420p"
        st.options = {"preset": "p4", "tune": "ll", "rc": "vbr", "cq": "23"}
        i420 = np.empty((h * 3 // 2, w), np.uint8)
        for i in range(n):
            cv2.cvtColor(frames[i % 30], cv2.COLOR_BGR2YUV_I420, dst=i420)
            f = av.VideoFrame.from_ndarray(i420, format="yuv420p"); f.pts = i
            for pk in st.encode(f):
                c.mux(pk)
        for pk in st.encode():
            c.mux(pk)
        c.close()
        os.remove(p)
    elif work == "mjpeg_mux":
        import av
        from fractions import Fraction
        p = str(path) + ".mkv"
        c = av.open(p, "w")
        st = c.add_stream("mjpeg", rate=60)
        st.width, st.height, st.pix_fmt = w, h, "yuvj420p"
        for i in range(n):
            pk = av.Packet(jpegs[i % 30]); pk.stream = st; pk.time_base = Fraction(1, 60); pk.pts = pk.dts = i
            c.mux(pk)
        c.close()
        os.remove(p)
    elif work == "py_overhead":
        idx = np.zeros(16, np.int64)
        rec = np.recarray(1, dtype=[("ts", [(f"t{j}", np.int64) for j in range(9)])])
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(20):
                idx[j % 16] = i
                _ = int(idx[(j + 1) % 16])
            for j in range(9):
                setattr(rec.ts, f"t{j}", i)
    return n / (time.perf_counter() - t0)


def proc_target(work, h, w, wid, start_evt, q):
    frames, jpegs = prepare(work, h, w, wid)
    q.put(("ready", wid))
    start_evt.wait()
    c0 = time.process_time()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    fps = do_work(work, h, w, frames, jpegs, wid, "proc")
    q.put(("done", wid, fps, time.process_time() - c0, time.perf_counter() - t0))


def run_threads(work, h, w, n):
    data = [prepare(work, h, w, i) for i in range(n)]
    res = [None] * n
    bar = threading.Barrier(n)

    def t(i):
        bar.wait()
        res[i] = do_work(work, h, w, data[i][0], data[i][1], i, f"thr{n}")
    ths = [threading.Thread(target=t, args=(i,)) for i in range(n)]
    c0 = time.process_time()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for x in ths:
        x.start()
    for x in ths:
        x.join()
    el = time.perf_counter() - t0
    return res, 100 * (time.process_time() - c0) / el


def run_procs(work, h, w, n):
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    q, ev = ctx.Queue(), ctx.Event()
    ps = [ctx.Process(target=proc_target, args=(work, h, w, i, ev, q)) for i in range(n)]
    for p in ps:
        p.start()
    for _ in ps:
        q.get(timeout=300)
    ev.set()
    out = [q.get(timeout=600) for _ in ps]
    for p in ps:
        p.join(30)
    cpu = sum(o[3] for o in out) / max(o[4] for o in out) * 100
    return [o[2] for o in out], cpu


def main():
    import proto_common as pcm
    h, w = pcm.SIZES["1080p"]
    sel = [a for a in sys.argv[1:]]
    works = sel or ["imdecode", "msmf_write", "h264_nvenc", "mjpeg_mux", "py_overhead"]
    tag = "benchvenv" if "simplejpeg" in works else "skellycamvenv"
    out = dict(env=pcm.env_summary(), rows=[])
    for work in works:
        one, cpu1 = run_threads(work, h, w, 1)
        thr, cput = run_threads(work, h, w, N)
        prc, cpup = run_procs(work, h, w, N)
        row = dict(work=work, frames_per_worker=FRAMES[work], single_fps=one[0], single_cpu_pct=cpu1,
                   threads_aggregate_fps=sum(thr), threads_slowest_fps=min(thr), threads_scaling=sum(thr) / one[0], threads_cpu_pct=cput,
                   procs_aggregate_fps=sum(prc), procs_slowest_fps=min(prc), procs_scaling=sum(prc) / one[0], procs_cpu_pct=cpup)
        out["rows"].append(row)
        pcm.write_json(f"p7_topology_{tag}.json", out)
        print(f"{work}: single {one[0]:.0f} fps | 5 threads agg {sum(thr):.0f} slowest {min(thr):.0f} x{row['threads_scaling']:.2f} cpu {cput:.0f}% | "
              f"5 procs agg {sum(prc):.0f} slowest {min(prc):.0f} x{row['procs_scaling']:.2f} cpu {cpup:.0f}%", flush=True)
    # merge md
    import json
    rows = []
    for t in ("skellycamvenv", "benchvenv"):
        p = pcm.RESULTS / f"p7_topology_{t}.json"
        if p.exists():
            rows += json.loads(p.read_text())["rows"]
    L = ["# P7 - topology: 5 workers as threads in one process vs 5 spawned processes (1920x1080, unthrottled)", "",
         "scaling = aggregate fps / single-worker fps (5.0 = perfect). CPU % = process CPU time / wall (100 = 1 logical CPU).", "",
         "| workload | frames/worker | 1 worker fps | 5 threads: aggregate / slowest fps (scaling) | 5 threads CPU % | 5 processes: aggregate / slowest fps (scaling) | 5 processes CPU % |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in rows:
        L.append(f"| {r['work']} | {r['frames_per_worker']} | {r['single_fps']:.0f} | {r['threads_aggregate_fps']:.0f} / {r['threads_slowest_fps']:.0f} (x{r['threads_scaling']:.2f}) | "
